--- title: "Hands-on Exercise 6: Geographical Segmentation with Spatially Constrained Clustering Techniques" author: "Kang-Chih Huang" date: "2026-10-01" date-modified: "last-modified" format: html execute: warning: false freeze: auto --- ## Getting started ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pacman::p_load(sf, spdep, tmap, tidyverse, corrplot, ggpubr, heatmaply, GGally, cluster, ClustGeo, factoextra, NbClust, psych) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` There is a binary version available but the source version is later: binary source needs_compilation psych 2.6.5 2.6.9 FALSE package 'mnormt' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked package 'GPArotation' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked The downloaded binary packages are in C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpY3g9p2\downloaded_packages ``` ::: ::: ## Importing geospatial data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} shan_sf <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "myanmar_township_boundaries") %>% filter(ST %in% c("Shan (East)", "Shan (North)", "Shan (South)")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Reading layer `myanmar_township_boundaries' from data source `C:\Users\User\Desktop\Geospatial\Hands-on_Ex\Hands-on_Ex06\data\geospatial' using driver `ESRI Shapefile' Simple feature collection with 330 features and 14 fields Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON Dimension: XY Bounding box: xmin: 92.17275 ymin: 9.671252 xmax: 101.1699 ymax: 28.54554 Geodetic CRS: WGS 84 ``` ::: ::: ## Importing aspatial data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ict <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Shan-ICT.csv") ``` ::: ## Deriving ICT penetration rate ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ict_derived <- ict %>% mutate(RADIO_PR = Radio / `Total households` * 1000, TV_PR = Television / `Total households` * 1000, LLPHONE_PR = `Land line phone` / `Total households` * 1000, MPHONE_PR = `Mobile phone` / `Total households` * 1000, COMPUTER_PR = Computer / `Total households` * 1000, INTERNET_PR = `Internet at home` / `Total households` * 1000) %>% rename(TS_PCODE = `Township Pcode`) ``` ::: ## Joining spatial and aspatial data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} shan_sf <- left_join(shan_sf, ict_derived, by = "TS_PCODE") ``` ::: ## Exploratory data analysis ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ggplot(data = ict_derived, aes(x = RADIO_PR)) + geom_histogram(bins = 20, color = "black", fill = "lightblue") + labs(title = "Distribution of Radio penetration rate") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ggplot(data = ict_derived, aes(x = RADIO_PR)) + geom_boxplot(color = "black", fill = "lightblue") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tm_shape(shan_sf) + tm_polygons(fill = "RADIO_PR", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals( style = "jenks", n = 5, values = "brewer.blues"), fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Radio penetration rate")) + tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) + tm_title("Distribution of Radio penetration rate by township") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## Correlation analysis ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cluster_vars.cor <- cor(ict_derived[, 12:17]) corrplot.mixed(cluster_vars.cor, lower = "ellipse", upper = "number", tl.pos = "lt", diag = "l", tl.col = "black") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Hierarchical clustering ### Extracting clustering variables ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cluster_vars <- shan_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(`Township Name`, RADIO_PR, TV_PR, LLPHONE_PR, MPHONE_PR, COMPUTER_PR) %>% rename(TS_NAME = `Township Name`) row.names(cluster_vars) <- cluster_vars$TS_NAME shan_ict <- select(cluster_vars, -TS_NAME) ``` ::: ### Standardising the clustering variables ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} shan_ict.std <- normalize(shan_ict) summary(shan_ict.std) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` RADIO_PR TV_PR LLPHONE_PR MPHONE_PR Min. :0.0000 Min. :0.0000 Min. :0.0000 Min. :0.0000 1st Qu.:0.2544 1st Qu.:0.4600 1st Qu.:0.1123 1st Qu.:0.2199 Median :0.4097 Median :0.5523 Median :0.1948 Median :0.3846 Mean :0.4199 Mean :0.5416 Mean :0.2703 Mean :0.3972 3rd Qu.:0.5330 3rd Qu.:0.6750 3rd Qu.:0.3746 3rd Qu.:0.5608 Max. :1.0000 Max. :1.0000 Max. :1.0000 Max. :1.0000 COMPUTER_PR Min. :0.00000 1st Qu.:0.09598 Median :0.17607 Mean :0.23692 3rd Qu.:0.29868 Max. :1.00000 ``` ::: ::: ### Computing proximity matrix ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} proxmat <- dist(shan_ict, method = "euclidean") ``` ::: ### Computing hierarchical clustering ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hclust_ward <- hclust(proxmat, method = "ward.D") plot(hclust_ward, cex = 0.6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### Comparing clustering linkage methods ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} m <- c("average", "single", "complete", "ward") names(m) <- m ac <- function(x) { agnes(shan_ict, method = x)$ac } map_dbl(m, ac) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` average single complete ward 0.8131144 0.6628705 0.8950702 0.9427730 ``` ::: ::: ### Determining optimal number of clusters ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(1234) gap_stat <- clusGap(shan_ict, FUN = hcut, nstart = 25, K.max = 10, B = 50) fviz_gap_stat(gap_stat) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-15-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### Interpreting the dendrogram ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plot(hclust_ward, cex = 0.6) rect.hclust(hclust_ward, k = 6, border = 2:5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-16-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### Visually-driven hierarchical clustering with heatmaply ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} heatmaply(normalize(shan_ict), Colv = NA, dist_method = "euclidean", hclust_method = "ward.D", seriate = "OLO", k_row = 6, margins = c(NA, 200, 60, NA), fontsize_row = 4, fontsize_col = 5, main = "Geographic segmentation of Shan State by ICT indicators", xlab = "ICT indicators", ylab = "Townships") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Mapping the clusters ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} groups <- as.factor(cutree(hclust_ward, k = 6)) shan_sf_cluster <- cbind(shan_sf, as.matrix(groups)) %>% rename(CLUSTER = `as.matrix.groups.`) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} qtm(shan_sf_cluster, "CLUSTER") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-19-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## Spatially constrained clustering: SKATER method ### Converting to SpatialPolygonsDataFrame ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} shan_sp <- as_Spatial(shan_sf) ``` ::: ### Computing neighbour list ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} shan.nb <- poly2nb(shan_sp) summary(shan.nb) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Neighbour list object: Number of regions: 55 Number of nonzero links: 264 Percentage nonzero weights: 8.727273 Average number of links: 4.8 Link number distribution: 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 5 9 7 21 4 3 5 1 5 least connected regions: 3 5 7 9 47 with 2 links 1 most connected region: 8 with 9 links ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plot(st_geometry(shan_sf), border = grey(.5)) pts <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(shan_sf)) plot(shan.nb, pts, col = "blue", add = TRUE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-22-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ### Computing minimum spanning tree ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} lcosts <- nbcosts(shan.nb, shan_ict) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} shan.w <- nb2listw(shan.nb, lcosts, style = "B") summary(shan.w) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Characteristics of weights list object: Neighbour list object: Number of regions: 55 Number of nonzero links: 264 Percentage nonzero weights: 8.727273 Average number of links: 4.8 Link number distribution: 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 5 9 7 21 4 3 5 1 5 least connected regions: 3 5 7 9 47 with 2 links 1 most connected region: 8 with 9 links Weights style: B Weights constants summary: n nn S0 S1 S2 B 55 3025 76267.65 58260785 522016004 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} shan.mst <- mstree(shan.w) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plot(st_geometry(shan_sf), border = gray(.5)) plot(shan.mst, pts, col = "blue", cex.lab = 0.7, cex.circles = 0.005, add = TRUE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-26-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ### Computing spatially constrained clusters using SKATER ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} clust6 <- skater(edges = shan.mst[, 1:2], data = shan_ict, method = "euclidean", ncuts = 5) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} groups_mat <- as.matrix(clust6$groups) shan_sf_spatialcluster <- cbind(shan_sf_cluster, as.factor(groups_mat)) %>% rename(SP_CLUSTER = `as.factor.groups_mat.`) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} qtm(shan_sf_spatialcluster, "SP_CLUSTER") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-29-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## Spatially constrained clustering: ClustGeo method ### Non-spatially constrained hierarchical clustering ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nongeo_cluster <- hclustgeo(proxmat) plot(nongeo_cluster, cex = 0.5) rect.hclust(nongeo_cluster, k = 6, border = 2:5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-30-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} groups <- as.factor(cutree(nongeo_cluster, k = 6)) shan_sf_ngeo_cluster <- cbind(shan_sf, as.matrix(groups)) %>% rename(CLUSTER = `as.matrix.groups.`) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} qtm(shan_sf_ngeo_cluster, "CLUSTER") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-32-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ### Spatially constrained hierarchical clustering ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dist <- st_distance(shan_sf, shan_sf) distmat <- as.dist(dist) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cr <- choicealpha(proxmat, distmat, range.alpha = seq(0, 1, 0.1), K = 6, graph = TRUE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-34-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-34-2.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} clustG <- hclustgeo(proxmat, distmat, alpha = 0.2) groups <- as.factor(cutree(clustG, k = 6)) shan_sf_Gcluster <- cbind(shan_sf, as.matrix(groups)) %>% rename(CLUSTER = `as.matrix.groups.`) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} qtm(shan_sf_Gcluster, "CLUSTER") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-36-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## Visual interpretation of clusters ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ggplot(data = shan_sf_ngeo_cluster, aes(x = CLUSTER, y = RADIO_PR)) + geom_boxplot() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-37-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} keep_vars <- c("RADIO_PR", "TV_PR", "LLPHONE_PR", "MPHONE_PR", "COMPUTER_PR") ggparcoord(data = shan_sf_ngeo_cluster, columns = match(keep_vars, names(shan_sf_ngeo_cluster)), scale = "globalminmax", alphaLines = 0.2, boxplot = TRUE, title = "Multiple parallel coordinates plot of ICT variables by cluster") + facet_wrap(~ CLUSTER) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-38-1.png){width=960} ::: :::
